implementation.writer: A dedicated std thread uses the existing atomic temp-write/sync/replace preference store. UI uses nonblocking result polling, never a blocking join or filesystem save. implementation.commits: Settings/theme proposals become app state only after successful writer acknowledgment. Failure/disconnect cannot commit them. implementation.ordering: Only one filesystem write is active. Welcome-message flags and internal persist requests arriving during a save are deferred/deduplicated, then persisted from current state after acknowledgment. Reset followed by a newly viewed feature preserves the new flag without restoring old cleared flags.
implementation.failure: Failures remain scoped to the originating page. A failed pending close returns to that page and exposes the error; it does not emit Close and a subsequent close is allowed. implementation.close: Pending writes emit egui CancelClose while frames remain live; the final acknowledged write permits Close. No automatic close follows a failed/disconnected writer. Slow filesystem I/O can still postpone save completion/closing; no hard latency bound is claimed.
implementation.feedback: Existing yellow fully rounded spinner status appears only on the save owner page and when it would not duplicate an active maintenance progress state.
